description:
Compute daily order revenue totals, mean daily revenue, and identify the peak revenue date using SQL subqueries.

Aggregating over an already-aggregated subquery table allows computing second-order statistics without procedural loops.

### Query Logic & Formulation
$$
\operatorname{AVG}(\text{daily\_total}) \quad \text{FROM} \quad (\operatorname{SUM}(\text{revenue}) \quad \text{GROUP BY order\_date})
$$

### Relational Execution Steps
1. Aggregate transaction revenues by order_date using inner subquery
2. Compute average daily revenue across the aggregated temporal rows
3. Identify peak revenue day

### Expected Query Output
Dictionary with 'daily_revenue', 'average_daily_revenue', and 'busiest_day'.
